'''Flingeld''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Flingeld was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Flingeld studied as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quilljayk]] on the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. When it was time to take his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Flingeld traveled to the ruins of [[Kaleth]] to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] near a large [[meditation crystal]]. His master had tasked him with moving a large boulder through his meditations, but Flingeld grew frustrated with his inability to complete the task and asked another Padawan to do the trial instead.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLS}}
Master Quilljayk was displeased with his student's failure and did not allow him to graduate to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Having failed the trials, Flingeld was assigned to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Archives]] where he would serve the Order as a clerk. Flingeld blamed the other Padawan for ruining his chances of becoming a Jedi, but Quilljayk stated he was never meant to accomplish a feat meant for Masters, but to learn enlightenment and perseverance.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Flingeld is a non-player character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] in the [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] mission, "Commune With the Light", which is exclusive to Jedi Knights and Jedi Counselors.<ref name="TOR" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
The player(s) have two dialogue choices with Flingeld:
*Tell Quilljayk that Flingeld was lying about not asking for help, resulting in the latter being sent to the archives, earning the player light side points.<ref name="TOR" />
*Tell Quilljayk that the player(s) volunteered to help him, resulting in the player(s) gaining dark side points and Flingeld gaining a second chance to prove himself.<ref name="TOR" />
